prompt: A surge of new land erupting from cracked brown earth, fresh emerald grass and saplings bursting upward through splitting soil, clods of dirt and rock flung into the air, vivid green growth overtaking a barren clearing. Deep emerald and moss-green tones. The background is a dim old-growth forest with dappled canopy light filtering through.

A robed druid kneeling with both hands pressed to the ground, coaxing a new hill of mossy green earth to rise and heave upward beneath their palms, roots and grass spilling outward. The druid wears forest-green and brown leather. Shimmering green nature magic glows where hands meet soil. The background is a shadowed forest floor of ferns and tree trunks.

Worms-eye low angle of thick gnarled roots and brown soil heaving upward, a single sapling explosively shooting toward the sky and unfurling into a young tree, clods of earth and bright green leaves scattering. Deep emerald foliage, rich loamy brown dirt. The only light is a warm green glow at the base of the sprouting trunk. The background is a darkened forest at dusk.

A verdant tide of grass, vines and wildflowers sweeping across a barren grey wasteland, the dead cracked dirt visibly transforming into lush green meadow as the wave passes, a clear line between dead ground and living land. Vivid lime and emerald greens against ash-grey barrens. The background is distant green hills rising under a pale sky.

A glowing acorn cracked open in dark soil, an explosive geyser of twisting green vines, ferns and roots bursting upward and outward from it in a fountain shape, dirt spraying out around the base. Deep emerald and golden-green tendrils. The seed glows with soft green light. The background is a dim forest clearing, tree trunks in shadow.

A whole hill of green land violently thrusting up out of flat barren ground, a raised mound of soil crowned with grass, ferns and young trees rising like an island pushing out of the earth, soil and rocks cascading off its sides. Rich loamy brown and vivid emerald. The background is a wide low plain with a forest edge on the horizon at dawn.

Extreme close-up of a single seed splitting open in dark crumbly soil, a bright green sprout exploding upward in a burst of unfurling leaves and tendrils, droplets of dew and flecks of dirt suspended in the air around it. Vivid lime-green sprout, deep brown earth. The only source of light is a soft green glow from the sprout. The background is blurred forest-floor shadow.

Thick green vines and roots erupting explosively from a fissure in dry cracked clay ground, lashing upward and outward like a fountain of foliage, chunks of broken earth thrown aside, fresh grass spreading rapidly from the crack. Deep emerald vines, ochre cracked clay. The background is a barren scrubland turning green at the edges under an overcast sky.

A druid in green and brown leather, seen from behind, both arms raised, as a forested mound of new land surges up from the ground in front of them, complete with grass, boulders and saplings, soil pouring off the rising terrain. Shimmering emerald nature magic streams from the druids hands into the earth. The background is a deep shadowed forest with shafts of green light.

A spreading carpet of moss, grass and mushrooms rapidly overgrowing a patch of bare brown dirt, tiny saplings and ferns unfurling in fast-forward across the soil, a few earth clods kicked up at the leading edge of the growth. Vivid mossy greens, warm brown earth, dappled sunlight. The background is a sunlit forest glade with ferns and tree trunks.
